explain.profit: Kita is what the store really earned: everything sold (cash and utang) minus what those goods cost you, minus the gastos you paid. Owner take-out is not counted.
explain.flow: This bar splits everything that came in. The first part paid for your goods, the next paid gastos, and the rest is your kita.
explain.sales: Money from cash checkouts only. Utang is not a sale until the suki pays it.
explain.utang: Credit your sukis still owe you right now, counting every unpaid record. You collect it later.
explain.stock: What the goods on your shelves cost you to buy. If everything sells, it brings in the retail amount shown.
explain.expenses: Gastos you recorded as paid in this period, like rent, kuryente, or supplies.
explain.trend: Cash sales per day, and how customers paid: cash now or utang for later.
explain.top: Which products sold the most, and which earn the most tubo per piece.
explain.stock_section: How many pieces left the shelves, which products move fast or slow, and what needs restocking.
explain.aging: How long unpaid utang has been waiting. The older it gets, the harder it is to collect.
explain.cashbook: Each day's drawer: the cash you started with, what you counted, and any shortage or overage.
